A row/column simplex cover has nerve K_mn with contractible intersections, establishing the integral b² three-sphere wedge. r2 = Cl(S(K_mn)^2) is the triangle-free case of Adamaszek Theorem5.1 and its explicit collapse identifies the r1 H1 map integrally. The graph cycle rank b, diameter4, and integer distances finish all ranges and barcode. Checker independently confirms adjacency taxonomy, diameter and cycle rank for five boundary cases; finite verification is not the proof.

value.rationale: The once-subdivided biclique is a canonical two-parameter incidence family. Its graph-metric persistence has an abrupt circle-to-3-sphere transition with quadratic rank b² at the first threshold where all original-to-midpoint vertices meet. Exact homotopy type and entire integral/any-field persistence are natural previously unreported invariants of this family; they are not determined by Betti numbers or routine renaming alone. The join decomposition explains structurally why the dimension jumps and makes the all-parameter classification usable for benchmark computations.
